name: search
description: Find stocks and ETFs by name or ticker. Costs 1 API call.

name: get_trending
description: Most discussed stocks, ETFs, sectors or countries on Reddit, X, News or Polymarket, with buzz and sentiment. Default period: today. Costs 1 API call.

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: One of reddit, x, news or polymarket.

name: get_ticker
description: Buzz, sentiment and activity of one stock per source, with up to 2 snippets, the top places and the Polymarket pulse. Default: every source, last 7 days. Costs 1 API call per source.

arguments.name: include_history
arguments.desc: Add the daily buzz history. Default false.

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: Default: every source that has the data.

name: explain_ticker
description: Short AI explanation of why a stock is discussed on Reddit, X and News. Stocks only, no period. Costs 1 API call per source.

name: get_mentions
description: Professional plan only. Latest posts, tweets, articles or Polymarket markets about one stock on one source. Default: last 7 days. Costs 1 API call.

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: One of reddit, x, news or polymarket.

name: compare_tickers
description: Compare buzz and sentiment of up to 10 stocks on one source. Default: last 7 days. Costs 1 API call.

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: One of reddit, x, news or polymarket.

arguments.name: include_history
arguments.desc: Add the daily buzz history. Default false.

name: get_market_sentiment
description: Overall buzz and sentiment of the stock market per source, with the top 5 drivers. Default: every source, today. Costs 1 API call per source.

arguments.name: include_history
arguments.desc: Add the daily buzz history. Default false.

arguments.name: sources
arguments.desc: Default: every source that has the data.

name: analyze_text
description: Professional plan only. Sentiment label and score (-1 to 1) of a finance text, with the engine behind the Adanos data. Costs 1 API call.

name: get_usage
description: Your plan, API calls used and left this month, the reset date and every plan with its price and limits. Free when signed in with an account; with an API key it costs 1 API call.
